articles.title: 绿联首款 60W AVS 屏显充电器发售：可智能识别苹果 iPhone 18 Pro Max、iPhone Duo 等机型
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，绿联新推出了一款“60W 速显充”氮化镓充电器产品，属于原先 45W 型号的升级版，型号 X740，京东自营店显示为 109 元，天猫旗舰店显示 99 元。京东绿联【苹果 AVS 协议】60W 速显充适用苹果 18pro max 充电器头氮化镓屏显 iPhone17/Duo 手机 TypeC 线快充插头 109 元直达链接据商品页面介绍，该产品为绿联首款 60W AVS 屏显充电器，采用第七代氮化镓（GaN）方案，支持苹果 AVS 可调电压电源协议与 PD 3.2 快充，可智能识别 iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max、iPhone Duo、iPhone 17/16/15 系列及 iPad、MacBook Air 等设备。官方数据显示，该充电器跑满 iPhone 18 Pro 峰值功率，15 分钟可约充至 50%（绿联实验室从 0% 测试）；同时 15 分钟可为 MacBook Air 约充 21%、iPad Pro 2025 年约充 25%。AVS 动态快充可智能识别充电各阶段所需电压，以 100mV 精细调压，分极速、高效、柔缓三档动态输出，降低损耗并保护电池健康。其正面搭载绿联自研「超感智能屏」，可实时显示功率、协议、电压、电流、温度与充电状态，并可一键开启 PPS 协议优先，兼容华为、小米、三星、iQOO 等安卓机型快充。其屏幕支持 180° 翻转、45° 黄金视角，并内置趣味小猫动画，可在充电时直观查看设备识别、温控与功率数据。温控方面，绿联采用自研 Thermal Guard 系统与石墨片 + 灌胶双核导热，全天 1080 万次测温，表面温度低于国标约 23.5℃。据介绍，这款充电器单 USB-C 接口最高 60W 输出，机身净重约 96g，具备国标 3C 认证与 10 重安全检测，提供 18 个月质保。IT之家附产品参数如下： 京东 绿联【苹果 AVS 协议】60W 速显充适用苹果 18pro max 充电器头氮化镓屏显 iPhone17/Duo 手机 TypeC 线快充插头 109 元 直达链接

articles.title: 在 Apple TV 看女车手飙车：苹果将直播 F1 Academy，上海站明年 4 月开启
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，苹果宣布扩大旗下 Apple TV 平台的赛车内容布局，将于 2027 年引入全女性赛车系列赛 F1 Academy。IT之家查询公开资料，F1 Academy 是一级方程式（F1）旗下的全女性单座赛车系列赛，于 2022 年创立、2023 年正式开赛，属于 Formula 4 级别。该赛事是一条面向年轻女性车手的职业发展通道，帮助她们积累比赛经验、提升体能与技术，进而向 F3、F2 乃至 F1 晋级。赛车运动长期由男性主导，女性车手从卡丁车、初级方程式进入更高级别赛事时，往往缺少足够的比赛里程、训练资源和职业曝光。F1 Academy 的目标希望填补这一“断层”，为女性提供系统的赛道训练、正式比赛和职业成长机会。2027 赛季将于 2027 年 3 月 19 日开赛，将进行 7 站比赛，赛程从 3 月的沙特吉达开始，途经中国上海（2027 年 4 月 16~18 日，地点是上海国际赛车场）、加拿大蒙特利尔、英国银石、匈牙利亨格罗林、美国奥斯汀，最终于 11 月在拉斯维加斯收官。根据官方公告，苹果 Apple TV 将提供排位赛和正赛的完整直播内容，用户可通过 Apple TV 应用并订阅 Apple TV 服务观看。该媒体指出这是苹果扩大赛车内容布局的重要一步。苹果目前是美国一级方程式（F1）的独家转播商，相关合作协议预计将持续至 2031 年。将 F1 Academy 纳入 Apple TV，意味着苹果不仅继续覆盖 F1 顶级赛事，也开始向培养女性车手的系列赛延伸。

articles.title: OPPO Watch 5 轻薄小方表开售：机身厚 9.2mm、重 25g，国补后 764.15 元起
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，OPPO Watch 5 轻薄小方表今日 10:00 开售，新品售价 899 元起（国补后 764.15 元起）。据IT之家此前报道，OPPO Watch 5 采用超轻薄设计，机身厚度仅 9.2mm，重量低至 25g，主打“美得无负担”的佩戴体验。新品支持灵感表盘 DIY 功能，用户可利用丰富模板轻松制作个性化表盘，将自己的照片或“喜欢的人”定制到表盘上；同时支持通过分享码与好友互换同款表盘，一键即可获得心仪设计。针对健身人群，OPPO Watch 5 推出 FatMax 超燃脂模式，可为用户提供专属燃脂心率区间指导，并以燃脂克数直观量化运动成果。运动过程中，表盘会实时显示当前心率、所处燃脂区间、运动时长及累计燃脂总量。手表还内置状态评估功能，可根据监测数据给出“元气爆表”“心平气和”“轻松自在”“能量重启”等状态标签及对应状态值，帮助用户随时掌握自身精神与身体状态。OPPO Watch 5 支持 13 项睡眠监测，提供睡眠评分与睡眠呼吸暂停监测功能。手表可完整记录用户从入睡到起床的睡眠结构，并统计总睡眠时长，帮助用户科学评估睡眠质量。针对女性用户，新品支持经期预测功能，通过结合腕表温度监测数据，使经期预测更加精准，可提前提示经期到来时间。借助全场景流体云功能，OPPO Watch 5 可在腕上直接呈现航班开始值机提醒、网约车司机已到达通知，以及高铁列车发车提醒（包括车次、座位、检票口等关键信息），覆盖高铁、飞机等出行场景，让用户旅途中无需反复掏出手机。续航方面，OPPO Watch 5 常规使用可达 7 天，最长续航 10 天，即使开启屏幕常亮也能坚持 3 天。京东 OPPO Watch 5 764.15 元直达链接

articles.title: Visa、万事达卡接连通报网络攻击事件：部分用户数据泄露，支付网络未受影响
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，继 Visa 之后，美国最大银行摩根大通与万事达卡于当地时间 11 月 19 日先后披露旗下第三方服务商遭遇网络攻击，部分客户信息可能因此泄露。此前，Visa 也已确认其一家第三方服务商发生安全事件。三家金融机构均表示，自身核心业务系统或支付网络未受到影响。摩根大通周四发布公告称，为该公司提供服务的第三方服务商遭到网络攻击。根据目前的调查结果，攻击者可能获取了这些服务商存储的部分营销数据，其中可能包含部分客户姓名和电子邮箱地址。摩根大通表示，公司业务运转正常，此次事件没有造成服务中断。在适当情况下，银行将直接联系受影响客户，并提供包括免费信用监测在内的支持服务。该行没有披露遭到攻击的第三方服务商名称，也没有公布攻击发生的具体时间。万事达卡同日也披露了一起第三方服务商安全事件。该公司发言人表示，万事达卡近期收到通知，一家第三方服务商发生安全事件，导致参与某项特定权益计划的少量持卡人电子邮箱地址遭到泄露，涉及的信息不属于支付数据。万事达卡强调，此次事件没有影响其支付网络，也不会影响持卡人正常使用银行卡。目前信息泄露范围已经得到控制，公司团队正配合相关服务商，根据实际情况为受影响的持卡人提供协助。Visa 本周早些时候也表示，获悉一家第三方服务商发生安全事件。Visa 发言人称，该事件涉及亚太地区的一家第三方服务商，Visa 自身系统没有受到影响，也没有银行卡号等支付数据遭到泄露。IT之家此前报道，在过去一周里，美国各大平台或机构接连出现大规模宕机事故，但各公司或机构均表示“无网络攻击迹象”。据路透社报道，一个名为 n0n 的网络勒索组织于当地时间 11 月 16 日宣称获取了摩根大通的持卡人营销互动记录，并公布了相关数据。同样在 11 月 16 日，n0n 还发布了涉及 Visa 和万事达卡的数据及相关说法。路透社审查发现，疑似 Visa 的数据主要涉及亚太地区市场，包括中国香港、中国台湾、韩国、日本、菲律宾、新加坡、马来西亚、澳大利亚和中国澳门等地，包含数千个疑似客户电子邮箱地址、电话号码及营销活动数据。相关数据的真实性同样尚未得到独立验证。该组织公布的万事达卡相关数据则涉及北美、中东和非洲地区的客户营销信息，以及少量万事达卡员工电子邮箱地址。

articles.title: 摩根大通陷入数据泄露风波：黑客宣称已掌握 1.6 万个客户邮箱
articles.content: IT之家注：IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，摩根大通（JPMorgan Chase）昨日（11 月 19 日）发布公告，确认为其提供服务的第三方供应商遭到网络攻击，部分客户姓名和电子邮箱可能已被攻击者获取。摩根大通表示目前已直接联系受影响客户，并称该事件与本周早些时候部分客户遇到的交易处理故障无关。据路透社报道，摩根大通发言人称，初步调查显示，攻击者访问了供应商保存的部分营销数据，其中可能包含客户姓名及电子邮箱地址。银行尚未披露受影响客户的具体数量，也未说明是否涉及账户密码、银行卡号或交易信息等更敏感资料。自称名为“n0n”的网络勒索组织宣称获取了相关营销记录，其中包括超过 1.6 万个客户电子邮箱，部分记录还涉及电话号码和邮政编码，此外还有 124 个摩根大通员工电子邮箱。该组织还声称掌握与 Visa 和万事达卡相关的数据，两家机构均将相关说法指向第三方供应商。Visa 表示，支付数据未受影响；万事达卡则确认存在有限的邮箱信息暴露，并强调客户仍可正常使用银行卡。相关阅读：《摩根大通发生重大系统故障，回应称并非网络攻击所致》

articles.title: 吉利星越 L PLUS 预计 12 月上市，搭 2.0T 混动、Flyme Auto 座舱，预售 15.77 万元起
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，据易车援引相关渠道消息，吉利星越 L PLUS 预计将于 12 月正式上市。该车已在 11 月 12 日开启预售，共推出 5 款车型，预售价区间 16.77-20.97 万元，预售先享价 15.77-19.97 万元。据IT之家了解，星越 L PLUS 的车身长度达到 4955mm，轴距增至 2900mm，整体规格相比现款星越 L 有明显提升。外观方面，新车采用吉利最新的家族化设计语言，提供乌金黑、甜釉白、青韵灰、郎窑绿、霜釉银等在内的六款车色。智能化配置上，新车按车型梯度有所区分。次顶配揽晖至尊版与顶配大师典藏版搭载激光雷达，配备英伟达 Orin-Y 辅助驾驶芯片，采用千里浩瀚 H5 高阶辅助驾驶方案，可实现城市领航辅助（CNOA）、高速领航辅助（HNOA）以及车位到车位领航辅助（D2D）等功能。而入门版揽晖悦尊版、次入门揽晖荣尊版及中配揽晖曜尊版则搭载地平线征程系列辅助驾驶芯片，支持 ACC 全速自适应巡航、ICC 智能巡航辅助、APA 智能泊车辅助和 RPA 遥控泊车辅助等主流功能。值得一提的是，新车车顶集成激光雷达模组，整车共配备 27 个高感知智驾硬件。车内采用全新设计风格：内嵌式全液晶仪表盘搭配三辐式多功能方向盘，中控屏与副驾娱乐屏组成一体式连屏，车机搭载高通骁龙 8295 芯片、Flyme Auto 智能座舱。其他配置还包括游艇式电子换挡杆、HUD 抬头显示、圆角矩形空调出风口以及带菱形纹理的皮质座椅。内饰提供栗烟红真皮、丹霞棕环保麂皮、云舒米皮质三种配色方案。动力系统上，星越 L PLUS 搭载吉利 i-HEV 智擎混动系统，由 2.0TD 混动高效发动机与 3DHT 12 合 1 电驱组成，发动机最大功率 160kW，极速 190km/h，主打低油耗表现。底盘方面，新车采用前双叉臂 + 后五连杆独立悬架组合，并同级首发搭载后轮转向系统，最小转弯半径仅 4.88 米，还支持蟹行模式。此外，车辆配备双腔闭式空气悬架，可根据路况自适应调节悬架软硬与车身高度，在操控性与舒适性之间实现动态平衡。

articles.content: “IT早报”时间，大家好，现在是 2026 年 11 月 20 日星期五，今天的重要科技资讯有：1. Anthropic 完成史上最大规模 IPO，上市估值达 1.5 万亿美元Anthropic 的发行价定为每股 83 美元（现汇率约合 554.5 元人民币），高于上周公布的预期区间，完全稀释后市值达到 1.5 万亿美元（现汇率约合 10.02 万亿元人民币）。>> 查看详情2. 苹果手机能用安卓 App 了：App Store 上架安卓虚拟机，iPhone、iPad 都能装一款名为“Andarium”软件现已上架苹果 App Store 平台。据介绍，这是一款安卓虚拟机软件，支持在 iPhone 和 iPad 上运行 Android 应用。应用内直接包含基于 LineageOS 的 Android 17 系统，完全在设备本地运行。>> 查看详情3. 27.99 万元起：比亚迪方程豹钛 9 上市，定位大六座方盒子新车首发 DMS 超级混动全能平台，WLTC 纯电续航 310km、综合续航超 1600 公里，配备 30 英寸全景巨幕屏、50 英寸 AR-HUD 与 2+2+2 六座布局。>> 查看详情4. 腾讯大幅削减元宝投入：没有我们预期的那样成功腾讯披露了微信 AI 助手小微的运营数据。腾讯总裁刘炽平也坦言，另一款 AI 助手元宝并未达到预期。>> 查看详情5. 1 厘米标尺竟有 12 个刻度，中南大学通报附属医院 AI 论文争议、确认存在学术不端行为中南大学表示，学校始终坚持对学术不端行为“零容忍”，将进一步加强科研作风建设，完善监督核查体系，坚决维护风清气正的学术生态。>> 查看详情6. 比亚迪发布 DMS 超级混动：DM-i 的能耗、DM-p 的性能、DMO 的越野DMS 平台整合 DM-i（节能）、DM-p（性能）、DMO（越野）三大技术路线，号称“为全能而生”；首创后驱矢量控制技术，融合差速器、差速锁、电子限滑、轮端解耦，实现“大而强、大而灵、大而稳、大而省”。>> 查看详情7. 华为最薄 Mate 直板机来了，Mate90 Air 轻薄旗舰定档 11 月 24 日发布作为华为史上最薄的 Mate 直板旗舰，华为 Mate90 Air 将在 HUAWEI Mate X8 及全场景新品发布会上正式亮相。>> 查看详情8. 方向盘也能折！方程豹钛 9 搭载比亚迪折叠智舱上市，全栈自研、全球首搭量产在 11 月 20 日晚的比亚迪方程豹钛 9 车型上市发布会上，官方宣布，方程豹钛 9 首搭比亚迪折叠智舱上市。比亚迪官方表示，这是比亚迪全栈自研、全球首搭量产的 2026 年度重磅科技成果。>> 查看详情9. 江淮汽车注册“帝境”商标，消息称与江淮、华为、玛莎拉蒂未来合作关系密切国家知识产权局商标局最新信息显示，安徽江淮汽车集团股份有限公司近期申请注册了“帝境”商标。据上海证券报报道，业内专家表示，帝境新商标与江淮、华为、玛莎拉蒂的未来合作关系密切。>> 查看详情10. 黄仁勋女儿现身全员会、看起来“状态不错”，英伟达要提前发钱当地时间 11 月 18 日上午，英伟达在加州圣克拉拉总部召开全员大会，线下会议与微软 Teams 直播同时进行，全程近一小时。>> 查看详情11. 华为希望苹果调整 iOS 蓝牙配对机制，解决新旧版本配对兼容问题华为通过欧盟 DMA 渠道提出诉求，希望苹果允许按 iOS 版本控制 AccessorySetupKit 框架，兼顾新系统原生配对体验与旧设备传统连接流程。>> 查看详情12. 阿里巴巴 2027 财年上半年归母净利润 750.72 亿元，同比增长 17%阿里巴巴 2027 财年上半年营业总收入 5404.72 亿元、同比增长 9%；>> 查看详情13. 通体酒红色，全新比亚迪汉实车曝光本月早些时候，比亚迪王朝网销售事业部总经理路天宣布，11 月广州车展将推出一款“用户呼声很高的车型”。同时，比亚迪第三代唐 8 系大五座科技旗舰 SUV 正在上市筹备中，展车已经陆续到店。>> 查看详情14. 华为鸿蒙星河互联官宣支持流转 iPhone 来电，当前适配 Mate 90 系列、XT 2 非凡大师机型华为官方 11 月 19 日发布图文，介绍了鸿蒙星河互联带来的 HUAWEI + iPhone 双机互联的功能，包括网络共享、一键查找、消息 & 电话流转等。IT之家进一步查询获悉，电话流转功能当前仅 Mate 90 系列、Mate XT 2 非凡大师支持。其他华为手机支持接收 iPhone 侧未接来电通知。>> 查看详情15.

articles.title: 苹果 macOS 27.3 Beta 2 公测版发布：扩展 Siri AI 能力，强化完全磁盘访问权限管理
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，苹果于当地时间 11 月 19 日向公测版用户推送了 iOS / iPadOS 27.3 和 macOS 27.3 Beta 2，以及 tvOS 27.3 和 watchOS 27.3 的 Beta 2。据 9to5Mac 和 MacRumors 报道，此次更新延续了苹果在新一代操作系统中对 Siri AI、Safari 浏览器及系统隐私权限管理的调整。macOS 27.3 Beta 2 公测版的版本号为 26C5047e，与此前发布的开发者预览版 Beta 2 一致。此次更新的重点之一是新增针对完全磁盘访问权限（Full Disk Access）和自动化工具的隐私控制选项，同时扩大 Apple Intelligence 在中国市场的可用性。在此前发布的 macOS 27.3 Beta 1 中，苹果已经加入 Safari 垂直标签页和自适应深色模式，并为 Mac 引入原生实时活动（Live Activities）支持。此外，系统还增加了 Quick Look 对 Markdown 文件的渲染支持，以及针对通过 iCloud 链接分享潜在有害内容的额外检查机制。Siri AI 也是此次系统更新的重点。macOS 27.3 扩展了 Siri 在信息、音乐、日历、照片和提醒事项等苹果自有应用中的操作能力，同时支持管理文件和文件夹。苹果还为第三方开发者提供了新的开发工具，允许他们通过基于 Markdown 的指令构建更深入的 Siri AI 集成。语言支持方面，Siri AI 此前已在 macOS 27.3 Beta 1 中新增对繁体中文、挪威语、土耳其语和越南语的支持。苹果目前尚未公布 27.3 系统正式版的具体发布日期。MacRumors 预计，相关系统更新有望于 12 月正式推出。IT之家后续将保持关注。相关阅读：《苹果 iPadOS / macOS 27.3 DP Beta 2 系统更新后，国行 iPad 和 Mac 新增 Apple 智能》《如何在苹果 macOS 27.3 Beta 2 关闭菜单栏“蓝色药丸”提示》《苹果 macOS 27.3 开发者预览版 Beta 2 发布：细化应用授权，让用户管理更透明》

articles.title: 消息称苹果 iPhone 摄影关键人物麦考马克上月退休，曾主导 8 年影像研发
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，彭博社昨日（11 月 19 日）发布博文，报道称苹果 iPhone 影像团队核心人物乔恩 · 麦考马克（Jon McCormack）已于上月（2026 年 10 月）月底退休。IT之家援引博文介绍，麦考马克于 2018 年加入苹果，担任相机与照片工程副总裁，是 iPhone 相机、照片应用及影像算法开发的重要推动者之一。苹果尚未公开宣布其离职，也未披露接任安排。麦考马克在加入苹果前，曾任职于亚马逊和惠普。进入苹果后，他长期负责与拍摄全流程相关的技术工作，涵盖相机硬件与软件协同、图像处理、照片管理及拍摄体验等关键环节。过去 8 年，iPhone 影像能力持续增强，包括夜间模式、计算摄影、人像拍摄、视频防抖以及后期照片处理等，背后均有其团队的深度参与。彭博社指出不同于许多只负责单一硬件模块的高管，麦考马克被视为连接“相机工程”和“照片体验”的关键人物。用户按下快门后，从传感器采集、图像合成、色彩还原，到相册整理与编辑呈现的整条链路，都在其职责范围内。他的退休可能意味着苹果影像产品线将进入新一轮人事与产品方向调整。

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，OPPO Reno17 系列手机今日开售，搭载全焦段 4K 超清长实况，售价 3599 元起（国补后 3099 元起）。IT之家整理价格如下：Reno178GB RAM + 256GB 存储空间：3599 元，国补后 3099 元12GB RAM + 256GB 存储空间：3799 元，国补后 3299 元12GB RAM + 512GB 存储空间：3999 元，国补后 3499 元12GB RAM + 1TB 存储空间：4899 元，国补后 4399 元京东 OPPO Reno173099 元起直达链接Reno 17 Pro8GB RAM + 256GB 存储空间：4199 元，国补后 3699 元12GB RAM + 256GB 存储空间：4599 元，国补后 4099 元12GB RAM + 512GB 存储空间：4999 元，国补后 4499 元京东 OPPO Reno17 Pro3699 元起直达链接新机提供 IP69K 认证，由宋雨琦代言，采用金属中框，光学指纹，提供奇遇喵、冰月白、可可棕、初雪白四款配色。其中“奇遇喵”版本采用了 3D 冰透悬浮工艺 2.0，后置摄像模组采用了一体冷雕玻璃设计。其中，Pro 版机型搭载 6.32 英寸 1.5K LTPS 显示屏，标准版搭载 6.56 英寸 1.5K LTPS 显示屏，Pro 版机型搭载天玑 8550 处理器，标准版搭载骁龙 7 Gen 4 处理器。新机搭载“全焦段 4K 超清长实况”，首次将实况时长由原先 3 秒延长至 6 秒。同时引入全新 Natural Color 色彩还原引擎，和 Natural Tone 3.0 真实感引擎，可改进人像拍摄效果。手机还引入了“实况调色盘”功能，可以方便用户调节照片主色调。具体规格方面，其中 Pro 版机型前置 50Mp 摄像头，后置 200Mp 主摄 +50Mp 超广角 + 50Mp 3.5X 潜望长焦；而标准版同样前置 50Mp 摄像头，采用后置 50Mp 主摄 + 50Mp 超广角 + 50Mp 3.5X 潜望长焦。其他方面，Pro 版机型搭载 7250mAh 电池（支持 80W 有线充电），标准版机型搭载 8000mAh 电池（支持 80W 有线充电）。

articles.title: 微软携手英伟达升级云 PC 体验：两路 4K 60 帧画面，2027 年预览上线
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，本月召开的 Ignite 2026 活动中，微软宣布携手英伟达加速本地 AI 体验落地，让 AI 从“必须联网才能用”的云端服务，逐步走向“能在自己电脑上运行”的本地体验。根据双方公布的合作愿景，搭载英伟达 RTX Spark 的 Windows PC 能运行本地大语言模型能力，让用户不必完全依赖网络，就能在电脑上直接使用 AI 助手、生成内容或处理文档。本次双方合作为 GPU 加速的 Windows 365 云 PC，引入低延迟图形传输能力 Direct Stream，最多支持两路 60 帧 4K 画面，公开预览预计于 2027 年初推出。该功能可以把云端 Windows 电脑中由 GPU 渲染的画面，更高效、更流畅地传输到用户的本地设备，目标是让远程办公、设计、开发、虚拟桌面等场景更接近“本地电脑”的体验。传统云 PC 通常把整块屏幕画面压缩后通过网络传回用户设备，网络波动时容易出现卡顿、延迟或画质下降。Direct Stream 的重点在于优化这一传输链路，让云端 GPU 渲染的图形内容能以更低延迟、更高帧率送达用户屏幕。在任务体验方面，本地电脑承担响应更快、隐私更可控的日常 AI 应用，而对于复杂、消耗算力的任务，微软通过紧密连接英伟达的芯片、模型，以及微软的 Azure 云、Windows 系统，从而提供更卓越的云端 AI 响应。英伟达还发布了 Nemotron 3.5 系列模型，分为不同使用场景：Super 适合需要连续思考、执行复杂任务的智能体；Lightning 强调快速响应和工具调用；另有面向检索、文档解析和内容安全的配套模型。在“边缘 AI”落地方面，Azure Local 将支持英伟达 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU，并扩展至 Jetson Thor、Jetson Orin 等边缘设备，可用于机器视觉、机器人和自主运营。这意味着工厂摄像头、仓储机器人、工业设备，未来都可能直接在本地完成 AI 判断。在企业 AI 方面，微软 Foundry 新增对英伟达开放模型及定制能力的支持。开发者可通过无服务器“Programmed Training”服务控制后训练流程，并借助 Foundry Managed Compute 部署自定义模型权重。安永（EY）已使用该方案微调英伟达 Nemotron 开放模型，用于企业采购记录分类，评估数据集准确率提升 55%，成本较专有前沿模型降低至 15 分之一。

articles.title: 苹果发布 iOS 27.3 Beta 2 修订版：修复 HomeView 配对问题，Siri AI 可读取 Safari 完整网页内容
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，苹果于当地时间 11 月 19 日面向开发者推送了 iOS 27.3 Beta 2 和 iPadOS 27.3 Beta 2 的 v2 修订版，版本号均为 24C5049f，同时也面向公测版用户开放 iOS 27.3 Beta 2 更新。IT之家注意到，根据苹果开发者官方网站的更新记录，此次重新发布主要修复了 Siri AI 与苹果智能家居设备 HomeView 配对时可能出现的设置问题。苹果在更新说明中表示，此前版本存在一项已知问题：当 HomeView 与运行 iOS 27.3 或 iPadOS 27.3 测试版的 iPhone 或 iPad 配对时，设备上的 Siri AI 可能无法正确完成设置。此次更新针对这一问题进行了修复。值得注意的是，iOS 27.3 Beta 2 此前已经带来多项 Siri AI 功能升级。其中，Safari 新增了「Ask About Page」（询问网页内容）功能，允许 Siri AI 获取整个网页的内容作为回答依据，不再局限于用户当前屏幕上可见的部分。用户可以直接询问长网页中的具体信息，也可以让 Siri 根据网页内容提取资料。此外，iOS 27.3 测试版还扩展了 Siri AI 在系统应用中的操作能力，涉及日历、文件、邮件、地图、信息、音乐、备忘录、照片、Safari 和提醒事项等应用。用户可以通过自然语言指令，让 Siri 执行更多跨应用操作。苹果官方开发者文档显示，iOS 27.3 Beta 2 和 iPadOS 27.3 Beta 2 的更新内容还涉及 Siri AI、App Intents、Apple TV 视频播客、StoreKit 及开发者接口等多个方面。其中，与 Siri AI 相关的内容包括：新增 Video schema：App Intents 新增 Video schema domain，开发者可以将相关功能接入 tvOS、iOS、macOS 和 visionOS 平台的 Siri AI。其他更新还包括：Apple TV 视频播客：Apple Video Podcasts 已加入 Apple TV 应用，用户可以观看完整的视频播客节目，并从 Apple Podcasts 中断的位置继续播放。StoreKit 多席位订阅：新增多席位订阅支持，允许用户购买多个自动续费订阅席位，并邀请其他人加入。Core Image：CIRAWFilter 改为依赖操作系统之外的资源，开发者需要通过新增方法下载相关资源。来电识别接口：Live Caller ID Lookup 调整评估密钥管理机制，并对 PIR 配置中的分片数量提出新的要求。NEURLFilter：调整用户层级支持、PIR 分片数量限制，以及服务 URL 的配置方式。SwiftUI：修复部分使用 iOS 26 SDK 构建的应用在 iOS 27 上运行时，边缘柔化效果显示异常的问题。目前，iOS 27.3 和 iPadOS 27.3 正处于测试阶段，正式版发布时间尚未公布。相关阅读：《苹果 iOS / iPadOS 27.3 开发者预览版 Beta 2 发布：为 iPhone Duo 加入外屏面部解锁功能》《苹果 iOS / iPadOS 27.2 正式版发布：增强 Siri AI，更新 Apple Music 品牌视觉》

articles.title: 苹果正自研 AI 智能体：可操控设备、浏览网页、编写代码，以期与 OpenAI、Anthropic 竞争
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，彭博社马克 · 古尔曼（Mark Gurman）今日报道称，苹果正在开发自主 AI 智能体，计划让 AI 代替用户执行设备操控、应用操作、网页浏览和软件编程等任务，进一步进入由 OpenAI、Anthropic、Meta 等公司参与竞争的 AI 智能体市场。古尔曼发现，苹果已经在官网发布招聘信息，其中一份职位招聘面向高级工程经理，岗位名称为“主动式智能体 AI”（Agentic AI - Proactive）。招聘信息称，苹果正在组建团队开发能够代表用户执行任务的 AI 助手，相关系统将具备编写代码、浏览网页、控制应用程序以及操作设备等能力。苹果在招聘信息中描述了未来 AI 智能体的工作方式：用户可以让 AI 像熟练的人类操作者一样使用电脑，在浏览器、文档、终端、代码编辑器和各类服务之间切换，自主选择合适的工具完成任务。该系统不仅能够执行单一指令，还可以规划并完成跨应用、浏览器、命令行和 API 的多步骤任务，同时协调多个专门负责不同工作的子智能体。苹果还特别强调隐私保护，称这类能够运行代码、使用用户凭据并代表用户采取行动的智能体，需要具备严格的权限管理、沙盒隔离和操作透明度。不过，项目目前仍处于早期开发阶段，古尔曼称苹果曾考虑最早于 2027 年底推出相关服务，但这一时间安排尚未确定。苹果发言人没有回应彭博社的置评请求。古尔曼表示，苹果新任 CEO 约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）一直在推动软件工程负责人克雷格 · 费德里吉（Craig Federighi）加快 AI 开发进度，并采取更加积极的策略。自主 AI 智能体被视为苹果推进这一战略的重要组成部分。目前，AI 智能体市场已经出现多个竞争产品。Meta 的 Muse 近期凭借预订餐厅、安排旅行和生成新闻简报等能力吸引了大量用户；Anthropic 正在扩大自有智能体 Duet 的用户测试范围，OpenAI 也在持续扩展 Dots 的功能。谷歌本周则对旗下智能体进行调整，将其命名为 Tasks，并增加代表用户拨打电话等能力。与此同时，OpenAI、Anthropic 和马斯克旗下 SpaceXSI 也分别布局了 Codex、Claude Code 和 Cursor 等开发者编程工具。古尔曼指出，AI 智能体已经在苹果 App Store 中占据重要位置，截至当地时间周四，Meta 的 Muse 长期位居免费应用排行榜第二名，仅次于 TikTok，ChatGPT 和 Claude 也进入免费应用前五名。在推进自有智能体开发的同时，苹果也在调整 macOS 的第三方应用权限管理机制。即将推出的 macOS 27.3 测试版新增了针对第三方 AI 智能体的权限警告，要求用户在授予相关应用控制 Mac 的权限时重新确认。相关调整使 ChatGPT 用户启用第三方电脑操控工具所需的操作步骤从此前的 4 步增加到 14 步。一些 AI 公司和用户认为，这可能在保护系统安全之外，也会增加竞争对手接入 macOS 的难度。苹果方面则将相关调整解释为加强用户数据保护。苹果此前已于 11 月 16 日公布 macOS 27.3 Beta 2 的权限调整计划，涉及设备控制、数据访问和完全磁盘访问权限，重点是提高权限管理的透明度，并提供更细致的访问控制选项。除了独立 AI 智能体，苹果也在推进 Siri 与第三方应用的整合。即将推出的 iOS 27.3 将为开发者提供更深入的 Siri AI 集成能力，使语音助手能够调用外部应用完成任务，例如预订汽车或餐厅。不过，现阶段 Siri 与第三方应用的整合仍不同于完整的自主 AI 智能体。后者能够在后台跨多个应用和服务自主规划、执行复杂任务，减少用户在执行过程中反复提供指令的需要。相关阅读：《苹果新规遏制 AI 应用“全盘接管”Mac，古尔曼称提前 2 年铺路自家 AI 智能体》《苹果警告：AI 智能体行为或难以预测，恐引发诉讼、损害公司声誉》《Apple 智能官宣入华：阿里千问接入苹果生态，可帮用户写文案、读文档、识图像》

articles.title: Show HN: Wellness Tracker for AI Usage
articles.content:
Hello There,I built a small chrome extension to track my chat-based AI usage. I'm interested in understanding how I use AI conversationally, and how that affects my brain.AI as a means to efficiency is key in the modern world, but I don't believe that our brains are geared to process this level of information and authoritative posture over inconsistent technology, and so I just want to experiment.I would love some users or harsh feedback. Right now, we are not focusing on desktop tools, and it only works via browser -- No data tracked, no auth. Just a simple tracker.Let me know your thoughts!- Harrison

articles.title: 谷歌 Gemini 现可直接操作苹果 Mac 电脑，可跨应用操作、制作 PPT、填写表单
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，当地时间 11 月 19 日，谷歌宣布为 macOS 版 Gemini 应用推出全新的“电脑操控”（Computer Use）功能，允许 AI 直接操作 Mac 上的桌面应用、访问本地文件及浏览网页，独立完成多步骤任务（IT之家注：该功能目前面向美国地区的英语用户逐步开放）。根据谷歌官方介绍，用户只需通过自然语言描述任务，Gemini 就能在不同应用之间切换，执行点击、输入文字、填写表单及操作菜单等任务。谷歌列举的应用场景包括批量处理照片、从本地 PDF 文件提取信息并填写在线表单、根据实时数据制作演示文稿，以及整理商品信息并在二手交易平台上架销售等。在具体运行方式上，Gemini 会在独立的后台窗口中执行任务，不会占用用户当前的主屏幕和鼠标光标。聊天界面内还会显示实时操作预览，用户可以随时查看 AI 的执行过程，并暂停或停止任务。对于关键操作，Gemini 还会要求用户事先确认。权限管理方面，用户可以自行选择允许 Gemini 访问的应用程序，而不是直接向 AI 开放整个电脑的操作权限。谷歌表示，该功能需要搭载 Apple Silicon 芯片、运行 macOS Sequoia 15.0 或更新版本的 Mac，同时要求用户年满 18 岁并使用符合条件的个人 Google 账号及 Google AI Plus、Pro 或 Ultra 订阅。谷歌推出这项功能的时间，恰逢苹果着手调整 macOS 的应用权限管理机制。据苹果 11 月 16 日发布的开发者公告，macOS 27.3 Beta 2 已引入针对设备控制、数据访问和完全磁盘访问权限（Full Disk Access）的调整。新系统将原有的设备控制与数据访问设置拆分为不同权限选项，允许用户指定应用可以控制的具体程序或访问的文件夹，并提供每次请求权限时都需要用户确认的选项。苹果还将增加透明度提示，当某个应用通过相关权限控制其他应用时，系统会在菜单栏显示提示标识。苹果表示，授予应用完全磁盘访问权限可能使 Mac 上的各类数据面临风险，因此希望通过更细致的权限设置，让用户清楚了解应用能够访问和控制的内容。据 The Verge 报道，苹果此次调整与 AI 智能体日益普及所带来的安全风险有关。不过，苹果的相关权限调整早于谷歌此次发布 Gemini 电脑操控功能，并非针对这款应用临时作出的回应。

articles.title: “史上最大 IPO”：Anthropic 上市首日收盘大涨 17%，市值达 1.27 万亿美元
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，AI 公司 Anthropic 于当地时间 11 月 19 日在美国纳斯达克上市，首日股价以 97.17 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 649.2 元人民币）收盘，较 83 美元（现汇率约合 554.5 元人民币）的发行价上涨 17.07%。该股开盘即报 111.5 美元（现汇率约合 744.9 元人民币），较发行价高出约 34.3%；盘中一度突破 115 美元（现汇率约合 768.3 元人民币），随后回落至 100 美元（现汇率约合 668.1 元人民币）下方。按收盘价计算，Anthropic 市值约为 1.27 万亿美元（现汇率约合 8.48 万亿元人民币），成为全球最受关注的 AI 公司之一。不过，其每股收益为 -59.62 美元（现汇率约合 -398.3 元人民币），意味着公司仍处于高投入、尚未实现稳定盈利的阶段；市场目前更多是在为 AI 基础模型、企业级应用及未来商业化能力定价。IT之家查询公开资料，SpaceX 于 6 月 12 日在纳斯达克以 SPCX 上市，IPO 定价 135 美元（现汇率约合 901.9 元人民币），上市首日开盘 150 美元（现汇率约合 1,002 元人民币），收盘约 161 美元（现汇率约合 1,076 元人民币），市值突破 2.1 万亿美元（现汇率约合 14.03 万亿元人民币）。按照“IPO 募资额”计算，Anthropic 本次上市募资 813 亿美元（现汇率约合 5,431.47 亿元人民币），超过了 SpaceX 今年 6 月的 750 亿美元（现汇率约合 5,010.58 亿元人民币），成为有史以来最大规模的公开市场首次募股。SpaceX 在超额配售后合计募资 857 亿美元（现汇率约合 5,725.43 亿元人民币），高于 Anthropic 的 813 亿美元（现汇率约合 5,431.47 亿元人民币）；若把 Anthropic 额外的 260 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,737 亿元人民币）私募配售也算入，其总融资规模约 1,073 亿美元（现汇率约合 7,168.47 亿元人民币），则又明显超过 SpaceX。韩媒 ETNews 认为市场之所以给予高溢价，与其业务增长密切相关。截至 10 月底，Anthropic 的年化营收已突破 810 亿美元（现汇率约合 5,411.43 亿元人民币），约合 108 万亿韩元（现汇率约合 5,411.88 亿元人民币）；每年支出超过 10 万美元（现汇率约合 66.8 万元人民币）的企业客户也超过 1.19 万家。

articles.title: 512GB 版 Steam Machine 开放直接购买：2TB 版关闭等待名单，1 月公布新供应详情
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，Valve 今日发布 Steam Machine 硬件预订进展公告，宣布 512GB 型号已完成全部现有预订履约，等待名单清空，并已向所有剩余的 2TB 型号预订持有者发出购买邀请邮件。IT之家附 Steam 官方公告链接（https://store.steampowered.com/hardware/steammachine）。图源：Valve不过 Valve 同时表示，目前仍持续面临硬件组件供应紧张问题，零部件采购受到明显影响，其中 2TB 型号受冲击最为严重，等待名单上的用户数量已超过当前产能，即便后续能增产，规模也将远低于原定计划。Steam Machine 512GB 型号现已转为“加入购物车”状态，用户可直接购买，售完即止；当现有库存售罄后，将直接切换为缺货状态，不会再重新开放等待名单。Steam Machine 2TB 型号已向所有预订持有者完成购买邀请发放；当前在等待名单中的用户将保留原有排队位置，但 Valve 强调等待名单中的用户不保证一定能获得产品；由于等待名单人数已超过可供应数量，官方将关闭等待名单的新报名通道，产品页面文字将从“加入等待名单”变更为“缺货”；等待名单用户可选择转而购买 512GB 型号（库存充足时），但需注意该操作将失去在 2TB 等待名单中的排队位置；更多关于新增供应的细节，预计将于 2027 年 1 月公布。后续安排Valve 表示仍在持续生产更多 Steam Machine 设备，但内存与存储成本正以前所未有的幅度上涨，因此目前尚无法确定最终产能规模，也无法确定后续产品的定价，其中 2TB 型号的供应限制将尤为突出，相关更多信息同样预计在 2027 年 1 月对外公布。

articles.title: Counterpoint：今年 Q3 欧洲智能手机出货同比下滑 18%，创 13 年来多季度新低
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，Counterpoint Research 2026 年第三季度智能手机市场监测报告显示，欧洲智能手机市场出货量同比下滑 18%，创下超过 13 年以来的最低季度总量。报告指出，上游零部件成本大幅攀升推动终端设备售价上涨，各厂商同步缩减促销力度，叠加宏观经济环境疲软持续压制消费者需求，是本季度欧洲市场大幅下滑的核心原因。IT之家从报告获悉，Counterpoint 副总监 Jan Stryjak 表示，尽管本季度欧洲市场有多款重磅新品发布，但整体经营环境依然严峻。三星推出的“护照级尺寸”Galaxy Z Fold8 是西欧有史以来销量最快的折叠屏机型，但该机型的亮眼表现无法抵消 Galaxy A 系列等中低端产品线的疲软；苹果则发布了品牌首款折叠屏产品 iPhone Duo，但该机型直至 10 月才正式上架，基础款 iPhone 新品要到 2027 年第一季度才会发布，受空窗期影响，苹果在欧洲市场出货量创下自 2024 年第一季度以来的首次同比下滑。中国手机品牌在欧洲市场受到的冲击最为严重，多家厂商正在重新调整区域市场策略。当前行业普遍将保障经营利润率放在首要位置，由于多数中国品牌此前高度依赖欧洲快速萎缩的入门级市场，部分品牌开始转向影像爱好者、游戏玩家等垂直细分受众，或是将资源集中在少数高价值市场，放弃此前的泛区域扩张模式。Stryjak 补充称，第四季度历来是智能手机出货的传统旺季，今年也不例外，但零部件价格预计要到明年年中才会趋于稳定，欧洲智能手机厂商即将迎来的圣诞销售季仍将面临较大经营压力。

articles.title: Anthropic 完成史上最大规模 IPO，上市估值达 1.5 万亿美元
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，北京时间今天（19 日）深夜，AI 初创企业 Anthropic 正式登陆美股，以 813 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 5,431.47 亿元人民币）的募资额创下 IPO 历史纪录。公司 CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫代伊在纳斯达克敲响开市钟。“今天的上市让公司的财务基础更加稳固，也让我们更加坚定了做正确事情的决心。”Anthropic 的发行价定为每股 83 美元（现汇率约合 554.5 元人民币），高于上周公布的预期区间，完全稀释后市值达到 1.5 万亿美元（现汇率约合 10.02 万亿元人民币）。彭博社和路透社报道称，预计正式开盘后，Anthropic 股价还将上涨约 20%，达到每股 100 美元（现汇率约合 668.1 元人民币）左右。当地时间 18 日，Anthropic 还宣布向承销商出售 9.8 亿股股票，扩大后的发行规模使募资总额达到 813 亿美元（现汇率约合 5,431.47 亿元人民币），打破 SpaceX 今年 6 月 IPO 募资 750 亿美元（现汇率约合 5,010.58 亿元人民币）的纪录。Anthropic 成立于 2021 年，仅用了五年左右的时间，便有望跻身全球市值最高的上市公司之列。Anthropic 是首家上市的前沿 AI 研发机构，其股价表现将成为观察数万亿美元 AI 投资热潮的重要风向标。华尔街投资者和全球科技行业都在密切关注公司上市后的表现。Anthropic 于 10 月底提交的招股书显示，公司成立以来每年营收都呈爆发式增长，部分年份增幅甚至超过 1000%。2026 年上半年，Anthropic 营收达到 162 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,082.29 亿元人民币），远高于 2025 年全年的 46 亿美元（现汇率约合 307.32 亿元人民币）。但 Anthropic 也付出了巨大的财务代价。公司 2026 年上半年亏损 800 亿美元（现汇率约合 5,344.62 亿元人民币），主要源于一笔一次性费用，前九个月累计亏损进一步扩大至 1,040 亿美元（现汇率约合 6,948.01 亿元人民币）。随着 Anthropic 不断扩大算力资源投入，成本预计还会大幅攀升。算力主要由通常部署在数据中心的半导体芯片提供，是运行生成式 AI 的基础，也是 Anthropic 最大的支出项目。2026 年前九个月，公司在算力方面花费约 188 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,255.99 亿元人民币）。Anthropic 高管在招股书中写道：“开发前沿 AI 模型需要投入大量算力、资金和人力，开展可能持续数周甚至数月的大规模训练，每次训练的费用可能高达数百万美元。”Anthropic 还在招股文件中详细披露了旗下 AI 模型可能给人类带来的各种风险，包括被用于开发生物武器，或加剧世界各地的压迫行为。此前，员工曾担忧部分企业以不负责任的方式开发先进 AI 模型，阿莫代伊随后呼吁放缓最先进 AI 模型的研发速度。

articles.title: ChatGPT 新增“实时听写”功能：对着麦克风说话，语音能即时变文字
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，ChatGPT 今天宣布新增“实时听写”功能，用户对着麦克风说话时，语音就能同步转换成文字，不必等录音结束后再转写，让 ChatGPT 更快接收到语音指令。该功能将陆续向全球所有 ChatGPT 用户开放，覆盖网页版、桌面客户端及 iOS 和 Android 应用。使用时，用户只需点击音频波形，就能查看实时转写的文字，录音结束后还可以直接在输入框中编辑。OpenAI 还宣布，取消 ChatGPT 语音听写原有的 10 分钟时长限制，并进一步提高转写的可靠性。今年早些时候，ChatGPT 的双向语音对话模式曾迎来全面改版。OpenAI 去年还推出了用于转写语音笔记和会议内容的“录制模式”，不过仍处于测试阶段，仅面向 Plus、Enterprise、Edu、Business 和 Pro 工作区开放。据IT之家了解，用户也可以利用 ChatGPT 输入框的语音听写功能，让 ChatGPT 将语音消息转成文字，或整理成条列式要点。

articles.title: Google 杀入 Jev 核心赛道：Gemini Decision 1 五项基准领先两项落后
articles.content: Jev 拿下的 75 亿美元估值曾被质疑是一场泡沫。现在 Google 用一款多模态决策模型告诉市场：这不是泡沫，是赛道。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑  峰                                                                                                       谷歌正式入场了。刚刚，谷歌发布 Gemini Decision 1，正式向 两个月前引爆决策模型品类的 TypeSafe Jev发起挑战。和 Jev 一样，这款模型不生成任何文本，只计算供程序直接驱动 Agent 执行的候选项概率和置信度，不需要逐 Token 生成答案，连输出 Token 费用也省了。更大的突破出现在并行计算上。Gemini Decision 1 可以在同一份上下文中处理至多 1000 项独立判断，而且支持文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF 混合输入。对于需要反复检查文档、选择工具、评估任务状态的 Agent，大量原本分散在不同模型调用中的判断，现在可以集中在一轮请求中完成。在数据上，7 项双方均有报告的共享基准中，Gemini Decision 1 赢下 5 项，Jev 在 When2Call 工具调用和 Mind2Web 多模态上仍保持优势（82.0% vs 79.9%，86.8% vs 86.2%）。不过，Gemini 每 100 万输入 Token 收费 0.10 美元，是 Jev 的约 2.38 倍。性能上去了，价格也更贵了，谷歌显然想用更强的多模态能力和批量决策能力打开市场。Jev 在 9 月发布后数周内拿下 75 亿美元估值，a16z 领投 8.7 亿美元，约三分之一财富 500 强被列为客户。但质疑从未消散：厂商自报的“快 193 倍、便宜 445 倍”缺乏第三方复现，原创性争议尚未定论，独立评测指向同一个结论：快和便宜是真的，质量是另一回事。雷峰网Google 此时入场，至少证明了一件事：决策模型不是一场闹剧，而是一个值得巨头押注的品类。01模型怎样跳过文本生成完成决策普通 LLM 处理“从四个工具里选一个”这类任务时，仍然走自回归解码：逐 Token 生成工具名或 JSON，程序再解析执行。模型承担的是开放式文本生成，业务需要的却是有限候选项中的概率判断。Gemini Decision 1 把输出目标改成了候选项评分。开发者提前定义问题、候选集合和判断标准，模型读取输入后，直接返回各候选项的概率分布。整个过程通过单次前向计算完成，不需要逐 Token 生成答案，也没有输出 Token 费用。这和普通的 Structured Output 有明显区别。Structured Output 仍然让模型生成文本，只是通过 Schema 限定 JSON 的字段和格式，Gemini Decision 1 则直接围绕有限候选空间完成评分，返回结果本身就是程序可以读取的数据。这里有一个容易被忽略的细节：不同判断类型返回的概率含义并不相同。Noul 处理二元判断，返回某个条件成立的概率，范围为 0.01—0.99。如果问题本身存在歧义，开发者还可以分别定义什么情况算 Yes、什么情况算 No，减少判断标准不清晰带来的偏差。Choice 处理多分类问题，支持 2—255 个候选项，返回胜出选项以及各候选项的归一化概率，所有候选项概率之和为 1。它适合工具路由、模型选择和任务分类。不过，这种概率分配始终发生在给定的候选集合内，即使所有选项都不符合输入，模型仍会选出一个相对匹配的结果。因此，开发者需要提供 Other 选项，或者额外设置范围检查。Score 的设计更有意思。它并不简单返回一个等级，而是先给有序评分标准中的每个等级分配概率，再计算加权评分。例如，将问题分为 0 级、1 级和 2 级，模型可能给出 0.1、0.7 和 0.2 的概率，最终评分可以落在 1 和 2 之间。这实际上把离散分类扩展成了连续评分，方便程序进行排序和阈值筛选。不过，加权结果会压缩概率分布中的信息：两个输入即使

articles.title: 诺亦腾机器人入选 The Information 2026 全球最具潜力50家初创企业榜单
articles.content: 核心要点（Key Facts）· 在 The Information 于 11 月 11 日发布的“2026 全球最具潜力 50 家初创企业”榜单中，诺亦腾机器人（Noitom Robotics）位列亚洲分区第一。· 根据榜单披露，诺亦腾机器人目前估值已超 5 亿美元，累计股权融资逾 5000 万美元，年营收突破 1000 万美元。· 诺亦腾机器人致力于生产供机器人学习的人类数据。公司在中国深圳和美国加州山景城设有数据工厂，并已与物理 AI（Physical AI）领域的近百家企业展开合作。新加坡，2026年11月18日 —— 全球知名科技商业媒体 The Information 近日正式发布"The 50 Most Promising Startups 2026"榜单（全球最具潜力50家初创企业）。物理 AI 数据公司诺亦腾机器人（Noitom Robotics）在亚洲顶尖初创企业榜单（Top Asia Startups）中名列第一。Fig 1. The Information 2026 全球最具潜力50家初创企业榜单榜单数据显示，诺亦腾机器人当前估值已超5亿美元，股权融资总额超5000万美元，营收超1000万美元。The Information 创办于2013年，重点覆盖科技、人工智能与金融，面向全球60多个国家的商业领袖与专业读者提供原创独家报道和深度分析。The Information 50 榜单旨在发掘各细分赛道中最具龙头潜力的早期初创企业，围绕营收规模、商业模式及增长前景进行严格评估，相关财务数据由记者直接向创始人和投资人采集。诺亦腾机器人创始人兼CEO戴若犁博士表示："The Information 依据营收和增长表现对初创企业进行排名。去年，机器人研发团队对人类动作数据的需求还在千小时量级；今年，这一需求已跃升至数十万小时。同时对这些团队而言，另一个至关重要的问题是：具身模型能否真正从这些数据中学到东西。我们很高兴诺亦腾机器人能够获得 The Information 的认可。此次入选，也印证了解决'数据规模'与'数据可学习性'这两大痛点的巨大商业价值。"不造机器人，专注生产机器人学习的"数据"诺亦腾机器人并不制造机器人。公司专注于生产驱动机器人进化的高质量训练数据——通过自建数据工厂与广泛的线下合作场景，系统化采集人类动作、物体交互及日常行为数据，并通过旗下数据平台 ModalityNet（modalitynet.com），向全球机器人本体厂商与 AI 开发者提供标准化的多模态数据集。2025年正式分拆成立后，诺亦腾机器人凭借团队长达13年的动作捕捉技术积淀，快速构建起全球化的数据产能与服务网络。目前公司规模已超百人，在深圳和美国加州山景城（Mountain View）设有数据工厂，在台北和吉隆坡设有数据采集中心，正积极向全球其他地区拓展。截至目前，公司已与物理 AI 领域近百家企业及研发机构达成深度合作。过去一年融资、产品及研发里程碑不断此次入围 The Information 50，源于过去一年间公司在融资、产品及研发领域接连达成的一系列里程碑成果：2025年11月 — 公司完成由阿尔法公社领投，经纬创投（MPCi）、英诺天使基金等机构跟投的 Pre-A 轮融资。2025年12月 — 公司完成由启明创投领投，阿尔法公社、经纬创投、五源资本等跟投的 Pre-A+ 轮融资。2026年6月 — 诺亦腾机器人正式发布数据平台 ModalityNet，三大旗舰数据集产品同步上线。同期宣布完成数亿元人民币 Pre-A++ 轮融资，获北京市人工智能产业投资基金（顺禧管理）、上海人工智能产业系列基金、深创投等多家头部产业资本，以及阿尔法公社、君联资本、五源资本、经纬创投等老股东超额认购。2026年8月 — 高精度人机交互数据集 HiPHI（High Precision Human Interaction）上线，面向学术科研社区开放。HiPHI 是 HiPHI-MOV（Motion with Object and Vision，含物体与视觉的运动数据）语料库的开放研究子集，依据 ModalityNet 开放研究许可证（MORL v1.0）免费供研究使用，完整 HiPHI-MOV 语料库通过 ModalityNet 进行商业授权。目前在 Hugging Face 及公司分发渠道下载量已突破15,000次。2026年11月 — 在奥斯汀举办的机器人学习大会（CoRL 2026）上，诺亦腾机器人团队三篇论文获主会收录，同期重磅推出全新类别的真实场景人类数据集 ITW-Ego Plus，并公开了 HiPHI 系列的第二个开放研究数据集 HiPHI-Hand，该数据集已被用于

articles.title: 黄仁勋「每天都在用」的 Perplexity 开始重构 Attention，把「判断」做成了一个独立模型
articles.content: Decider v1.3：63 项分类任务准确率达 91.6%，对标 Jev 成本直降 61%。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       刚刚，黄仁勋每天都在用的「AI 导师」 Perplexity 有了新动作：正式推出 Decider v1.3，直接把 AI 系统里的判断能力单独做成了一套模型。Perplexity 这次直接改了模型处理判断任务的方式：同一份上下文可以同时交给多个问题使用，模型只需进行一次前向传播，就能输出各个问题的答案概率。 过去需要反复调用 LLM、生成文本、解析结果的流程，现在可以收敛到一次模型计算中。为了让多个问题共享计算时不互相干扰，Perplexity 还重新设计了 Attention 机制，让共享状态读取全部问题，同时限制问题之间直接交换信息。v1.3 进一步加入 Locate 能力，可以根据字段描述直接定位原文跨度，将判断与文本抽取整合进同一套架构。这套模型已经进入 Perplexity 的生产系统。在一次内部安全审查中，它单日处理了 7000 个 Agent 会话，累计读取 10 亿 token，并推动 14 项规则修复。从技术架构来看，Decider 有三个紧密关联的设计层次：输入端如何把共享上下文与独立问题组织在一起，注意力层如何控制不同问题的信息交互，训练与输出层又如何让同一套模型兼顾分类判断和文本定位。其中，隔离式问题注意力改变了多任务共享计算的底层方式，也是理解整个 Decider 架构的关键切口。01一份上下文，承载多个判断任务Decider 的输入其实是由共享状态（State）和若干问题块（Question）组成。State 保存网页、文档或 Agent 执行记录，Question 描述具体判断目标，并列出候选答案。每个候选项映射到预定义标签 Token，例如 A、B、C，特殊的 <|marker|> Token 则标记答案读取位置。模型处理时，会提取 Marker 对应位置的隐藏状态，交给决策头计算各候选项的分数，再转换为概率分布。这里的决策头由基础模型原有的语言模型输出层改造而来：Perplexity 保留 A、B、C 等候选标签对应的权重行，移除其余词表输出权重，再针对决策任务进行训练。原本用于计算下一个 Token 概率的输出层，由此转为专门处理选项判断。这个设计让任务定义与输出计算分离。调用方可以通过自然语言描述问题，通过选项限定答案空间，模型则负责根据上下文计算各选项的概率。情感分析、自然语言推理、意图检测、实体匹配、内容审核、事实核查和评分，可以采用同一套输入协议，不需要为每种任务单独建立一套模型结构。Perplexity 将数百个公开数据集转换为 State、Question、选项和目标组成的统一训练格式。训练目标既可以是正确标签，也可以是完整的答案概率分布。对于同一段长文本需要执行多项判断的情况，多个 Question 可以放进同一次前向传播，模型只需处理一份共享上下文。不过计算收益需要准确理解：增加问题仍然会增加 Question Token 和注意力计算，Decider 节省的主要是长文本被重复编码的开销，以及生成式模型逐 Token 解码和外部解析的成本。问题数量越多、共享文本越长，复用价值越明显。输出概率还保留了业务策略的调整空间。模型负责给出候选项的概率分布，应用根据误报、漏报的业务代价设置阈值。网页过滤和 Agent 执行审查可以使用不同门槛，无需为每种业务重新训练决策模型。02多任务如何共享信息，互不干扰输入协议确定后，新的问题落在模型内部：多个 Question 同时进入 Transformer，它们之间应该建立怎样的信息连接？Decider 以生成式 LLM 为骨干，原有因果注意力按照文本顺序组织信息，当前位置只能读取自身及前面的 Token。这种结构适合逐

articles.title: AI4S青年志②丨赋澈生物王子龙：实验室里的「企业家」
articles.content: 同时拥有理工科训练、结构生物学功底，和系统商科思维的创业者，在AI4S领域里并不常见。    作者丨周蕾    编辑丨岑峰                                                                                                       【编者按】AI4S有时给人“雷声大雨点小”之感，是因为不少人把AI当成了目的本身，拿着锤子满世界找钉子，对科研周期与商业回报的错配却无知无觉。“AI4S青年志”第二篇，我们关注一个可能破解AI4S落地困局的样本。一篇论文，通常只需要2-4位审稿人。但当《Nature Biotechnology》的编辑们打开一篇来自加州大学伯克利分校的投稿时，他们很快意识到，2-4位远远不够。为了覆盖这篇论文涉及的每一个学科，编辑们前后邀请的审稿人数量已经来到了两位数。论文横跨四个领域：合成生物学、材料科学、计算化学，以及技术经济学与碳排放核算。审稿人们上来就说：他们只能看懂属于自己的那一部分，无法对其他部分做出评价。学术论文通常像一辆概念车，但这篇论文，却被以量产车的标准来严苛审视。例如论文已经在实验室里证明，生物反应器中，新型塑料单体的滴度达到了1.84克每升——这是一个符合学术发表标准的数字。但一位材料学背景的审稿人直接追问：“如果这个平台要走向产业化，至少要让我看到几十克每升的可能性。”这些质疑，同时关乎科学和商业。而回应它的人，需要同时听懂四种语言。最终，四个不同领域的专家全部认可了这篇论文，编辑也点了头，论文在今年夏天成功刊发。这篇论文的署名栏里，第一作者只有一个名字：王子龙。在AI for Science的创业浪潮里，跨学科背景并不稀奇。计算机出身的人去学材料，化学出身的人去写代码，这样的故事比比皆是。但像王子龙这样，同时拥有扎实的理工科训练、结构生物学的底层功底，以及从本科阶段就开始的系统商科思维，并且能把这一切翻译成彼此能听懂的语言——这种人在AI4S创业者中，并不常见。借着论文刊发的机会，雷峰网AI科技评论和王子龙完成了一次两个多小时的越洋连线，从中山大学逸仙班的经济学课堂聊到Jay Keasling的实验室，从主动拒绝创业风口聊到放弃教职、投身产业，试图还原这位AI4S青年科学家，在他过去二十年里的每一次关键选择。01像“爱迪生”的底色王子龙儿时的梦想，是成为爱迪生那样的科学家。长大后他意识到，原来爱迪生不光是科学家，同时也是一名商人，而他恰好也将自己培养出了科学家+企业家的双重能力结构。这种能力结构的雏形，最早要追溯到本科时期。王子龙所就读的中大逸仙班，准入门槛极高，采用多学科混合培养的方式，除了数物化生的理工科内容，还有专门开设的经济学课程，由岭南学院的教授整套授课。加之出生于经商家庭，从事零售和分销，王子龙对商业实践已有着十几年的认知。逸仙班的课业负担不轻，但当时的多学科培养，尤其是经济学方面的训练，直到今天仍然在为他的商业工作带来极大的帮助。一方面经济学带给他反直觉的思维和理论，帮助他避免踩坑；另一方面，这套训练也为一位纯科学家在做商业谈判、市场判断时，提供了底气。“基本的商业逻辑、经济逻辑我们都清楚，对外融资、谈合作的时候，精神面貌是不一样的。”2011年，中山大学首次参加MIT创办的iGEM（国际基因工程机器大赛），正在读大三、准备出国留学的王子龙，正是当时参赛的领队和对外主讲人。队伍最终闯入了全球决赛。在MIT的讲台上，他要用英语向评委解释团队的成果；回到实验室，他又得和队友一起解决具体的科学问题。这个比赛最终帮他敲开了合成生物学认知的大门。也是在这个时期，他读到了一篇经典论文：用大肠杆菌和酵母菌全合成青蒿素前体。屠呦呦当年发现的青蒿素，在合成生物学的方法下，得以实现低成本、大规模的生产。而这位论文的作者Jay Keasling，后来成为了他在伯克利的导师。“我们可以改造自然界的微生物，让它们为人类所用，实现不同的功能。”合成生物学最底层的定义，是让每个基因的设计模块化，“像拼乐高一样拼基因，拼出不同的形态和功能。”王子龙被合成生物学深深

articles.title: NEBench R1: a Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Nuclear Domain Competence in Large Language Models
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21682v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for knowledge-intensive and safety-critical applications in nuclear engineering. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21832v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As AI systems are increasingly used to automate AI R&D, misaligned systems could sabotage research intended to improve model safety and alignment. To stress-test defenses against such sabotage, we use a human expert as a proxy saboteur on AI safety research. We conduct a red-team/blue-team game where a human researcher runs AI safety experiments from scratch and auditors try to tell which were sabotaged and how. Given access to the full research transcript and the ability to run experiments, human auditors mostly fail to distinguish sabotaged from benign research: they achieve an AUROC of 0.59, not significantly better than chance, and fully identify the specific sabotage in only 17% of cases. articles.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21885v2 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A language model is trained once and frozen. Making it better takes another training run, or a prompt, a harness or extra computation at inference that is gone once the task ends. We show a third way: to our knowledge for the first time, a language model rewrites its own weights by its own reasoning and becomes better, with no gradients and no training. We call this self-rewriting: the model is its own optimizer. In earlier work, a frontier model edited a much smaller one; here an open 27B model, given its weights, its graded answers and the ability to run itself, diagnoses its own failure and rewrites the weights behind it. It surpasses itself: its own edit makes it 6.6 points more accurate on problems it never saw. It keeps getting better: it tests its edits on practice problems and submits only what works, each edit improving on the last, and over eight consecutive sessions its accuracy only rises. Abstract: Speculative-diffusion decoding uses a small parallel drafter model to generate b draft tokens in one forward pass, which then undergo parallel verification via a larger target model. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21946v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A reasoning model that has reached a correct answer can lose it by continuing to think. Deciding whether to stop means comparing two probabilities at the same point of a chain: that the answer the model would give if stopped now is correct (its commitment), and that the answer it will finish with is correct (its verdict). We show that the verdict alone, which is what final-correctness probes estimate, cannot make this comparison. As a forecast of a fixed outcome it has no predictable drift, whether continuing helps or hurts. The commitment-verdict gap equals the expected remaining change in answer quality and the accuracy gained by stopping. A second identity splits any accuracy-versus-budget curve into answer change within chains and change in which chains are still running. We measure both on MATH-500. Abstract: The regulation of Artificial Intelligence is susceptible to various forms of capture by industry actors that hold undue influence over the policymaking process, due in part to their information advantage in developing these technologies. Abstract: AI agents can assist scientific research, but balancing autonomous investigation with scientists' ability to inspect and redirect ongoing work remains a central design challenge. Abstract: Large language models are moving from isolated assistants toward autonomous agents that can plan, use tools, and coordinate with others, motivating an emerging Agentic Web of independently developed agents and services. Abstract: Personal assistants accumulate months of conversations, but today's long-term memory stacks put derivation or selection between a question and its evidence. In a system-level comparison on LongMemEval, two commercial assistants scored well below the same model reading the history offline [1], consistent with, but not isolating, content loss between write and read. We propose KV-LTM: a memory tier storing each session's raw text plus its KV cache under a fixed reader model, answering by restoring cached sessions and appending the question. Abstract: Counterfactual explanations are often seen as counterfactual conditionals under closest-world semantics, requiring one to reason over all minimally distant counterexamples. Abstract: We describe the solver we submitted to the second round of the SOICT 2026 contest on the Integrated Passenger and Parcel Transportation problem, a selective pickup-and-delivery routing problem with time windows, open routes and heterogeneous taxis. arXiv:2611.23246v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Nearly all current methods for computing reachable sets of nonlinear dynamics propagate them with truncated Taylor expansions plus rigorous remainders. The expansion is pointwise: once its argument is a whole set rather than a point, one polynomial must stay accurate across that set, and it reaches only as far as its disc of convergence. The limit binds hardest on the rational terms and sigmoid gates of modern controllers: smooth as these look on the real line, in the complex plane they blow up at points just off the real axis, closer as a gate sharpens, and those points cap the set width a Taylor expansion can cover, most tightly on the switching surface where the controller decides. We prove a dichotomy: no Taylor degree certifies sets wider than that cap, while a Chebyshev abstraction of equal degree, anchored to the whole set in the same polynomial-zonotope pipeline, has no cap and gains width at a geometric rate in degree. articles.title: Budgeted Proper Loss Design for Uncertain Decision Thresholds
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23247v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A binary probability estimate may be used by several decision makers with different error costs. Proper scoring rules can emphasize selected probability thresholds, but a single average threshold distribution need not give a good worst-case regret guarantee. We study the choice of a proper loss when the threshold distribution belongs to a finite specified family. Among integrable loss weights with a positive pointwise floor and a fixed total mass, we derive the weight that minimizes the sharp, distribution-free multiplier from surrogate regret to threshold-averaged decision regret. The solution clips a rescaled upper envelope of the threshold densities at the prescribed floor; its normalization is found by a one-dimensional root search. We give proofs of sharpness, optimality, and stability under density misspecification, as well as a limitation for atomic threshold laws. articles.title: Exploring Parkinson's Diagnosis Using Machine Learning Techniques
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23248v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In recent years, machine learning (ML) techniques have emerged as promising tools for accurate and timely diagnosis of Parkinson's disease (PD) which is an incurable neurodegenerative disorder. This study explores the integration of ML algorithms and PD diagnosis, highlighting their potential applications in various aspects of the disease. ML methods such as support vector machines, decision trees, multilayer perceptron, k-nearest neighbours, logistic regression and random forest (with and without particle swarm optimisation) were applied on a PD dataset obtained from Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust containing data from 58 people. In terms of accuracy, the Decision Tree and Logistic Regression performed the best with scores of 72-76% while multilayer perceptron was least effective. articles.title: Optimize the Cob, Then the Kernel: Optimizing Beam Search for Generative Recommendation Inference
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23339v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) inference differs substantially from conventional LLM serving, featuring long input sequences, wide beam search, and only a few fixed output tokens. Existing LLM serving engines such as vLLM process beams as batched independent sequences, causing redundant KV cache accesses over the shared prompt prefix. Furthermore, vLLM executes each beam search generation step as a separate engine invocation, incurring host-side beam processing overhead between decoding steps and substantial runtime KV block management in PagedAttention. Using Tree Attention, we concatenate beams along the sequence dimension to eliminate redundant KV accesses, and further optimize execution through pre-generated partial-attention masks, static KV cache allocation, loop-unrolled generation dispatch, TorchAir graph compilation, automatic operator fusion, and vocabulary-constrained decoding. articles.title: Confidence-Based Materials Data Quality Assessment via Domain Knowledge and Graph-Structured Learning
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23342v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The rapid development of materials machine learning relies on large-scale, heterogeneous datasets, yet model reliability is often compromised by imperfect data from diverse experiments, simulations, and database integration. Real-world materials databases may contain measurement errors, failed calculations, missing or duplicate records, and hidden violations of physicochemical constraints. Such problems are difficult to identify because corrupted samples may remain statistically plausible rather than appearing as explicit outliers. In this paper, we propose a confidence-based materials data quality assessment framework that integrates domain knowledge with graph-structured learning. Data quality is formulated as a continuous confidence estimation problem rather than a binary anomaly identification task, enabling sample-level assessment and historical-reference-based batch comparison. articles.title: BiMa-ECGSR: reconstructing the 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets with bidirectional state-space models
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23345v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Wearables and monitors record few electrocardiogram (ECG) leads; most diagnostic tools assume 12 leads. BiMa-ECGSR reconstructs the 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets with a bidirectional Mamba state-space encoder--decoder, as regression (BiMa-SR) or diffusion (DiBiMa-SR). Models were trained on PTB-XL for six input sets (I; II; I+II; I+II+V1; I+II+V2; I+II+V1+V4), see only the measured leads at inference, and were tested on the PTB-XL test fold (2,198 records) and two external cohorts (Georgia, 10,275 records; Chapman-Shaoxing/Ningbo, 43,559). From lead II alone, the pooled median Pearson correlation (PCC) over the 11 predicted leads was 0.914 on PTB-XL, against 0.784 for a least-squares linear filter (lead I: 0.906 against 0.789). As limb leads are exactly derivable from I and II, multi-lead inputs were compared on predicted chest leads: 0.939 against 0.849 for I+II and 0.979 against 0.962 for I+II+V1+V4. articles.title: Implementing Binary Transformers with Approximate Memories with Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) Protection
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23358v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Quantization is an effective technique to reduce memory storage, computation complexity and power for Transformers, and the binarization of the weights is important for meeting these requirements. Approximate memory can further reduce the power for memory, but it also introduces errors. Current research for binary Transformers focuses on task performance, but the model dependable operation against errors on the memory has not been well studied. In this paper, we first evaluate the dependability of binary Transformers with the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) as a case study. A large accuracy loss occurs only at high Bit Error Rates (e.g. BER = 5% or 10%). Then we propose a novel Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) scheme to protect the binary weights at very low overhead. articles.title: TRACE-MAS: Diagnosing and Repairing Collaboration Failures in Multi-Agent Systems
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23362v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on not only individual agent behaviors but also the interactions that connect agents, including message exchanges and task dependencies. Existing MAS safeguards mainly perform agent-level anomaly detection, which becomes insufficient when failures originate from agent interactions and detected anomalies do not necessarily reveal their true sources. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{TRACE-MAS}, a finer-grained framework for diagnosing and repairing MAS failures. TRACE-MAS learns normal collaborative execution patterns from benign trajectories and detects deviations in agent state changes, message transitions, and task dependency evolutions. It further identifies responsible execution elements through source-aware attribution and selects minimal interventions to restore collaboration while preserving task-critical capabilities. articles.title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23388v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. articles.title: Which Tokens, in What Order, and How Fast? A Theoretical Analysis of On-Policy Distillation Objectives
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23397v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model to match a teacher model based on its own generations. When using OPD, one must choose whether to apply it at the sequence or token level and which divergence to minimize. However, despite the wide adoption of OPD in practice, the formal understanding of which OPD objective is appropriate for a given setting is limited. Toward addressing this gap, we theoretically analyze how the choice of OPD objective governs which tokens are prioritized, in what order, and how efficiently. Our analysis reveals that sequence-level OPD exhibits a future agreement bias, which myopic token-level objectives avoid. This bias induces a reverse learning order, in which sequence-level OPD first matches the teacher at later token positions, while at earlier positions it can favor tokens that are improbable under the teacher, and thus often undesirable. articles.title: Incremental Roseland: Batch-wise Landmark Diffusion via Kernelized Sequential Karhunen--Lo\`eve Update
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23414v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Landmark diffusion (Roseland) computes a diffusion-map-style spectral embedding from the singular value decomposition of a degree-normalized data-to-landmark kernel matrix, at a cost far below that of full diffusion maps. It assumes, however, that all data are available at once. We introduce incremental Roseland (iRoseland), which casts the landmark affinity as a row-growing matrix whose SVD can be updated with a kernelized Sequential Karhunen--Lo\`eve (SKL) scheme. Degre correction is handled by a first order expansion about a reference mean kernel row and so that the landmark-side eigenbasis may be recovered from a single landmark-by-landmark eigendecomposition at each step. The presented method requires only a single pass over the data and runs in bounded-memory with state independent of the number of points processed. articles.title: Stability Does Not Mirror Plasticity: A Module-Level View of Declarative and Procedural Learning in Transformers
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23427v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Plasticity and stability in continual learning are typically studied at the entire-model level and in a task-agnostic manner, yet prior work has reported divergent conclusions across settings. Inspired by cognitive distinctions between declarative and procedural memory, we instead study how plasticity and stability vary across transformer modules and task types. In a controlled synthetic environment with clean measurement, we show a double dissociation: query-key (QK) and value-output (VO) projections are the most plastic on procedural tasks, whereas MLPs are the most plastic on declarative memorization. Stability, however, does not simply mirror plasticity: when learning a new procedure, updating QK retains over half of the stored declarative memory, while updating MLPs retains far less and updating VO loses roughly four-fifths. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23428v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We show that the importance of a LoRA adapter's initial input-subspace direction is regime-dependent, and we characterize this dependence in theory and experiment. This refines the recent view that spectral initializers help through update magnitude alone. Direction matters most when labeled data are scarce relative to the representation dimension and the activation subspace used for initialization captures supervised task structure. In this regime, the adapter's row span remains sensitive to its starting point, making task-aligned initialization especially useful. A spiked-covariance perturbation analysis characterizes the finite-sample stability of the estimated subspace. A first-step analysis of LoRA training explains why the subspace's alignment with the task matters and motivates an alignment coefficient $\rho$ that closely tracks gains across classification tasks. articles.title: Conformally Calibrated Adaptive Computation in Neural Operators
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23440v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Selecting less computation in a neural operator need not reduce inference time. We study this gap using conformal calibration to choose Fourier modes or channel width per input subject to a fixed error budget. A triangle-inequality envelope bounds all candidates simultaneously; a direct-score rule handles non-monotone candidate errors and, with an input-independent score, calibrates a static baseline under the same marginal guarantee. Under frozen-model and exchangeability assumptions, both rules bound the probability of issuing a prediction outside the budget and abstain when calibration is infeasible. On Burgers and Darcy flow across three training seeds, mode selection reduces active spectral support without a measurable latency reduction, because full-grid transforms and channel mixing dominate the cost. articles.title: FACT: Fixed-Budget Allocation and Cross-Step Training for Speculative Decoding
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23463v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model generation by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target-model pass. However, better draft predictions and longer accepted continuations do not necessarily produce faster generation. To examine this gap, we present FACT (Fixed-Budget Allocation and Cross-Step Training), an experimental framework for studying how drafter training, candidate allocation, and execution conditions jointly affect acceptance and latency. Using a lightweight feature-prediction drafter with a frozen Llama-3-8B-Instruct target under greedy decoding, we first examine how training translates into accepted tokens. articles.title: CrisisBench: an evaluation suite for crisis counseling AI
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21622v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Background: Crisis helplines are essential to mental health systems but are often understaffed and underfunded. LLMs could support counselors, but existing benchmarks do not capture the escalation, risk assessment, and de-escalation central to crisis conversations, while privacy restrictions limit use of real transcripts.
Methods: We present CrisisBench, a privacy-preserving suite for single- and multi-turn crisis counseling evaluation. It includes 1,085 single-turn tasks from 200 de-identified conversations and 1,185 patient LLMs derived from hotline metadata. Patient models and a 23-item LLM judge were calibrated against expert counselors.
Results: We evaluated five GPT models plus draft-then-edit and retrieval-augmented generation. All systems underperformed human counselors on excessive empathy and questioning in single-turn evaluation. articles.title: RAW: Refusal Aversion in the Wild, A Causal Measurement Method for Deployed LLMs
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21641v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Deployed LLMs field hundreds of millions of conversations a day and refuse a non-trivial fraction of user requests, yet the user-side cost of refusal, whether users disengage and by how much, is unmeasured on any production model: a blind spot for the consumer-facing platforms built on them. A/B-testing refusal is ethically and operationally constrained on frontier-lab products and unavailable to third-party platforms deploying these models through a fixed API. We introduce RAW, a method that uses LLM stochasticity as a natural experiment: at near-identical prompts in any existing log, the same model sometimes refuses and sometimes does not, and that variation identifies the causal user-side effect of refusal. articles.title: Sleep2Word: Peripheral-to-EEG Translation via Duration-Aware Wordization
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21643v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Estimating full-night electroencephalography (EEG) spectrograms from peripheral measurements could extend EEG-informed sleep analysis to recordings acquired without EEG. This task requires compact representations of signals with different temporal structures. We introduce Sleep2Word, a framework for translating respiration, electrocardiography (ECG), or photoplethysmography (PPG) into EEG spectrograms through duration-aware physiological words. Building on context-dependent chunking, Sleep2Word groups physiological embeddings into variable-duration chunks and jointly quantizes their content and duration into modality-specific wordbooks. A block-autoregressive translator then predicts target EEG word identities and occurrence-specific duration refinements within fixed-duration blocks. articles.title: MInfoVisQA: A Multilingual Benchmark for Information-Rich Visual Question Answering
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21644v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel in vision-language tasks; yet, whether they maintain consistent understanding of information-rich visuals (InfoVis) when the surface language changes remains unclear. To quantify this capability, we introduce MInfoVisQA, a parallel benchmark with 8,960 QA configurations derived from 128 seed instances across 24 languages. We construct seed-matched, language-parallel visuals and QA pairs by disentangling numerical-structural data from text and programmatically synchronizing translated labels. We evaluate 25 MLLMs under two settings: Language-Aligned QA (LQA, matching visual-text languages) and Cross-Language QA (XQA, fixed QA language with varying visual languages). The results show that aggregate accuracy masks substantial robustness gaps: two models with comparable mean LQA accuracy (80.4\%) exhibit performance spreads of 7.8 and 20.3 percentage points across languages. articles.title: Limite 1B - Violetto: Technical Report
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21646v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present Limite 1B - Violetto, a one-billion-parameter model designed for high-throughput mathematical reasoning. Limite is trained from scratch on 237 billion tokens from a carefully curated, mathematics-centric corpus and supports context lengths of up to 131k tokens. Its architecture and training recipe were developed together to maximize reasoning capability while keeping training and inference costs low. Post-training combines knowledge distillation, targeted supervised fine-tuning, and RLVR on a curated curriculum. Limite achieves 94.01% on AIME 2026 and 74.25% on BeyondAIME, placing it among models many times its size on our evaluation suite. The model is deliberately only lightly instruction-tuned: it is intended primarily as a single-turn mathematical solver and as a fast, parallel component of larger systems, rather than as a general-purpose assistant. articles.title: FieldGuide: A Corpus Map for Token-Efficient Agentic Document Exploration
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21647v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative AI agents can help journalists explore large document collections. But exploratory workflows can require substantial token use and time, especially when the task is broad and the relevant subquestions are not yet known. This paper introduces FieldGuide, an agent-facing corpus map that organizes a document collection into a topic hierarchy and exposes tools for corpus orientation, scoped search, and bounded reading. I evaluate FieldGuide on five journalistic document-exploration tasks using 38 Chicago Police Department public-records documents, comparing it with raw-file access and retrieval-augmented generation. Across the five tasks, FieldGuide used 27% fewer tokens and 41% less elapsed time than raw-file access; relative to RAG, it used 38% fewer tokens and 21% less elapsed time. articles.title: Can an LLM dream? Testing the overfitted brain hypothesis on an agent with text memory
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21648v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Hoel (2021) proposed that dreams distort replayed experience so that the brain does not overfit to recent events. We test this hypothesis on an LLM agent (Claude Opus 5.5) that stores what it learns in a text memory and rewrites that memory each night from the day's conversation transcript. The agent goes through ten simulated days of conversation built from LongMemEval. We corrupt 5, 10, 20 or 40 percent of the transcript's turns before each nightly rewrite in one of two ways. Detail corruption changes one or two details in a turn to plausible wrong ones, or replaces the turn with one by the same speaker from an earlier day. Random-text corruption replaces half of the selected turns with a passage of Moby-Dick and inserts Moby-Dick words into the other half. Abstract: In this paper, we propose an alternative approach to human evaluation of literary fictions by employing LLMs themselves as evaluators within the GrAImes framework. We apply this methodology to assess human-written and AI-generated microfictions in Spanish, to five PhD professors in literature and sixteen literary enthusiasts, and to short stories in both Spanish and English. Our analysis focuses on the alignment of responses from LLMs with those of human evaluators, providing insights into the potential of LLMs in literary assessment. articles.title: From Preference Data to Personalization: Tracing Sycophancy in Large Language Models
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21650v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Sycophancy in large language models is often measured as agreement with the user, yet agreement can be appropriate when the user's claim is valid, their preference is genuine, or their experience warrants acknowledgment. We study sycophancy as inappropriate agreement: validating a claim, preference, or self-assessment when the context calls for correction, qualification, or resistance. We introduce a validity-aware sycophancy grader and SycoDrift, a persona-targeted evaluation set of 3,298 validity-annotated probes with controlled annotations for user openness and stakes. We use this framework to analyze three sources of agreement pressure: human preference data, automated judge specification, and in-context personalization. First, preference for validating responses in human datasets (Chatbot Arena, HH-RLHF, Community Alignment) is weak and concentrated where agreement is often appropriate. articles.content:

Abstract: A controller that resamples an answer, escalates to a larger model, or abstains is usually justified by a confidence signal. Three claims about such a signal do not follow from one another: it ranks answers (discrimination), it supports withholding some of them (selective prediction), and it changes an answer for the better (correction utility). arXiv:2611.21669v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Masked diffusion models repeatedly predict provisional tokens before a sampler decides which predictions become permanent. Existing inference-time steering methods primarily modify activations, logits, or denoising trajectories, while treating this commitment policy as a fixed decoding detail. For the first, we introduce counterfactual target-aware commitment, which ranks unresolved positions by a mixture of model confidence and leave-one-token-out target contribution. For the second, we introduce calibrated adaptive budgets driven by target progress and confidence. Abstract: Realistic user simulation enables the study of human interactions when direct experimentation is costly or potentially harmful. Abstract: Language models are increasingly asked where real actors stand: what a party's platform prioritises, what an institution has committed to. Text about social entities carries far more comparison than measurement, so a model may hold a dependable ordering with no anchored scale beneath it. Abstract: Automatic assignment of ICD-10 codes from short clinical diagnosis text is a practical medical text classification and normalization task. Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on medical question answering and diagnostic reasoning benchmarks. Abstract: We present the Autoregressive View Model (AVM), which generates a scene as a stream of views without constructing an explicit 3D representation. Abstract: Attention maps cheaply show where a vision-language model (VLM) looks, but attention sinks make them unreliable for localization. Contrasting the question with a generic prompt suppresses sinks, yet only some layers localize the queried object. Existing methods find these layers with box annotations or fixed rules. The two effects separate exactly, and the second, measured in bits on unlabeled questions, indicates which layers localize. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23450v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Water does not just tint an underwater photograph; it rewrites it. Each pixel mixes attenuated scene radiance, backscattered light, and scene light scattered forward on its way to the camera, and many combinations of scene and water explain the same pixels. Most Gaussian-splatting methods for underwater scenes model only the first two effects and remove the water by dividing by a transmission that decays exponentially with range, so their inversion gain grows without bound. We present NIRJALA (Sanskrit for "without water"), a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that recovers water-free appearance and geometry together. TRIVENI, a three-path image formation model, adds a range-saturating forward-scattering term to direct transmission and backscatter; we prove that this keeps the inversion gain bounded at every range and bound how errors in the estimated backscatter and attenuation propagate into the recovered colours. Abstract: Training 3D vision-language models (VLMs) on large medical imaging datasets collected across institutions is constrained by data quality. Vast, uncurated pools of image-report pairs are characterized by redundancy, class imbalance, and cross-institutional heterogeneity. Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) encode images with 2D encoders that capture little 3D structure. A common approach is to feed the policy estimated depth, but a UAV chooses its own altitude, must judge distances tens of meters away, where monocular depth is less reliable, and must relate its forward and downward views. Abstract: Put a monocular mesh estimator behind every camera of a calibrated rig, and the reconstructed bodies land a meter or more apart. The cause is geometric: each estimate sits at the depth implied by a focal length the network assumed, not the one the camera has. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23581v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Semi-supervised multi-organ segmentation should learn more than a dozen organs from a handful of labeled scans, and the smallest organs occupy less than one percent of the foreground. We identify a failure mode of self-training that is specific to this regime. When a teacher misses a small organ in a scan, every voxel of that organ receives the confident pseudo-label background, and the student is trained toward the organ absence. Repeated over many scans, this loop extinguishes tail organs. In a pilot study, removing the gallbladder from the pseudo-labels reduced its Dice on AMOS from 36.5 to 1.0. We argue that a missing organ should be treated as unresolved rather than absent and propose Existence-aware Self-Training (ExiST). It builds pseudo-labels by leave-one-out consensus of independently trained networks, screens them with a quality gate on validation scans, and infers, per scan and per organ, whether the organ was found. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23591v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Unlabeled test data can improve the zero-shot classifier of a vision-language model, yet transductive and test-time adaptation methods often fall below the zero-shot baseline when only a few vocabulary classes are present in a batch or when streams are correlated. We trace this failure to a shared design: every class owns independent parameters estimated from its own samples, so absent or rare classes are left at biased text anchors or fitted to foreign samples. We propose Graph-Regularized Anchor-displacement Field Transduction (GRAFT), which models the adapted prototypes as text anchors plus a displacement field that is partially pooled over a semantic class graph through a Gaussian Markov random field prior, together with an explicit class-presence model. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23606v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Backward-compatible retrieval enables a new encoder to query the gallery that an old model has already encoded, so that a cross-modal retrieval system can be upgraded without re-encoding billions of items. Existing compatible methods either fit the old query and stay near the accuracy of the old model, or run the old and the new encoder for every query. We propose VIBRA, which matches relevance on the old gallery, corrects the errors of a single model with the barycenter of several views, which is itself a query in the old space, and trains the new encoder to inherit this consensus, so that models absent at deployment still shape every query. We show that the barycenter gains margin over the average of its views exactly when their hardest irrelevant items differ, and we characterize the share of this gain that one encoder can reach. articles.content:

Abstract: In weight-space programming, a language model edits a network's weights directly, without gradients. We ask what a successful repair of this kind relies on. We plant faults in the weights of two vision-language models, SmolVLM-256M and LFM2-VL-450M, and check each edit made by a coding agent against the original weights. Without being told where to look, the agent finds rescaled rows in the projector and noise in the vision encoder of both models, infers the unknown scale factors, restores most or all of the rescaled weights to their exact original values, and returns accuracy to near its original level; programs that it writes from such weights repair unseen checkpoints of the same model without feedback. Abstract: One-step flow maps are increasingly used as posterior samplers, where the point of sampling is the uncertainty that the samples carry. We find that the one-step sampler loses this uncertainty and becomes less stable. Compared with multi-step samples of the same network, its samples lose variance and decorrelate. Supervising the one-step jump directly makes this worse; the samples collapse further toward the conditional mean and break down when training is extended. We trace both failures to the locations where training places its pairs of start and end times. Abstract: Autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models predict discrete action tokens with the next-token objective of their vision-language backbone, so the action tokenizer defines the interface between the policy and the robot. In bimanual manipulation, the two arms share a repertoire of movements yet coordinate through complementary roles, and an action representation should capture both. However, most existing tokenizers encode both arms as a single concatenated action vector, in which motion patterns common to the two arms are not shared and cross-arm dependencies remain entangled within each token. The policy must therefore learn both aspects implicitly. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23502v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We introduce TAG (Testbed for Autonomous Games), a compact, low-cost robotic platform for studying learning and control in physically coupled dynamical systems. TAG combines an actively tilted and steered ball-in-maze board with a top-mounted rotary inverted pendulum. The pendulum's reaction torque and vibration disturb the board and marble, while the board's tilt, driven by the maze-solving policy, simultaneously disturbs the pendulum's balance. The main challenge in learning control policies for each subsystem is accounting for the impact of one subsystem's dynamics on the other's learning process. To address this challenge, we present complementary reinforcement learning paradigms, leveraging model-based and model-free approaches to learn the control policies for the maze and pendulum, respectively. Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models look saturated on LIBERO, yet most of them fall apart on LIBERO-PRO as soon as an object moves or the instruction asks for something new. We argue that what is missing is not scale but decoupling.

In the data, LIBERO demonstrations are re-arranged by general rules: every object and fixture is moved and rotated, tasks are carried into other environments and onto other surfaces, and every instruction is paraphrased. In the policy, a perception engine on frozen DINOv3 features, trained on this augmented data, hands the action model the scene in decoupled form: a list of objects with their positions, and a compact code of what the gripper is looking at, next to image and instruction embeddings from TinyCLIP. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23531v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Centimeter-scale robots are promising for urban search and rescue because they can enter confined spaces that are inaccessible or unsafe for humans. However, their small size limits obstacle traversal after deployment. This paper presents the RESCUE Jumper, a 125 g mobile robot with a 6.2 cm width and 6.2 cm diameter wheels that combines ground rolling with jumping to traverse steps and gaps that exceeds its rolling capability. The RESCUE Jumper uses its two actuators for both rolling mode and jumping by reversing the direction of wheel motion. Forward wheel motion enables rolling, while reverse wheel motion winds a spring steel tail to store elastic potential energy and release it for jumping. The RESCUE Jumper varies tail winding speed to control jump direction, transitioning from backward to forward jumps as winding speed increases from 0.75 rad/s to 8.73 rad/s. Abstract: Many learning-based approaches for deformable linear objects (DLOs) rely on simplified deformation models that neglect dynamic effects and the mechanical response of the objects, limiting their applicability to lightweight, compliant objects and slow motions. Abstract: Symbolic methods make robot designs interpretable but often overlook continuous geometry; learned methods handle geometry but offer less transparent structure. We introduce a typed production grammar that uses case-role relations, parameter inheritance, and specificity-based rule arbitration to generate both manipulation skills and robot morphologies. A geometric realization map translates grammar composition into transformations in SE(3), behaving as a monoid homomorphism when inheritance is inactive and exhibiting a measurable defect when inheritance is enabled. The grammar provides a compact representation, and its arbitration decisions can be recovered from geometric containment (agreement 0.905 +/- 0.062 across 10 seeds, versus 0.611 +/- 0.090 for a Euclidean control). articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23575v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Low-cost tactile arrays have made touch a practical input for robot learning, but piezoresistive designs sense only pressure, while camera-based sensors that also resolve shear are too bulky to tile over a gripper. To solve this problem, we present LuxTac, a flexible, scalable optical taxel array, about 3.5 mm thick and built from off-the-shelf parts. Each taxel is a digital RGBC light-to-digital converter under a translucent white silicone layer capped by an opaque black film, so the back-scattered LED light falls monotonically with local indentation depth. The same board accepts two interchangeable gel cartridges: a plain one for normal sensing, and one with colored walls that encodes the local shear in the color of the returned light, with no camera, magnets, or bump overlay, making LuxTac, to our knowledge, the first optical taxel array to resolve shear at individual taxels. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23585v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agricultural tasks such as harvesting and pruning require robots to reach through dense foliage, where contact is often unavoidable and vision is obstructed. Intermittent contact creates an imbalance between free-space and contact-rich observations, complicating the learning of contact-responsive behaviours. We present SPICE, a tactileconditioned diffusion policy for reaching targets in dense plant canopies using tactile sensing as the sole environmental feedback. SPICE exhibits three behaviours: moving through compliant foliage, manoeuvring around partially obstructing stems, and manipulating branches that block the target path. To the best of our knowledge, SPICE is the first tactile-conditioned diffusion policy for target reaching through physically cluttered plant canopies. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23589v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Safety certification in robotics typically rests on forward invariance of the deployed controller, a property that demands high-fidelity models at the edge of the operating envelope, exactly where models are least reliable and robots perform best. As a result, many of the behaviors we most want robots to run, from learned policies to aggressive maneuvers at the limits of traction, cannot be certified at all. We introduce recoverability, a contraction-theoretic safety concept that resolves this tension by certifying a robot's ability to reengage a trusted recovery mode rather than the invariance of a deployed behavior. We prove that switching to the recovery mode from anywhere inside a certified tube guarantees exponential convergence, even under disturbances and model error. Abstract: A frozen latent world model combined with sampling-based model predictive control is a visual planner. At deployment, the executed action can depart from the commanded one, and the frozen model has no way to notice. We show that the model can be run in reverse: for any hypothesized actuation shift, it predicts what it should have observed under that shift, and comparing this prediction with what was actually observed quantifies the shift and lets the planner correct itself. Unlike the residual energy, which mixes the shift with the model's own error, the score keeps only the part of the residual that a shift can produce. This shift score detects the shift with a locally optimal test, estimates it with Cramer-Rao error bars, names the dominant generator, and compensates the planner once an alarm fires. Abstract: Noise steering improves pretrained generative robot policies by learning to select their initial noise without updating model weights. However, the noise-steering methods we evaluate, in their published forms, struggle to scale to the high-dimensional noise inputs of large policy classes such as world-action models. We introduce Low-Rank Noise Steering (LoRN), a reinforcement learning method that scales noise steering to world-action models. A small steering actor selects a direction through a fixed low-rank random projection, while our norm-controlled construction keeps the resulting noise near the typical scale of a Gaussian sample. Range-based filters commonly reconstruct the required range rate from successive range measurements or from obstacle-state estimators, which can introduce estimator delay or sensitivity to range noise when obstacle motion changes. A measurement margin constructed from sensor error bounds accounts for errors in range, Doppler, ego velocity, and bearing. A limitation of VLA models is that most manipulation datasets focus on parallel-jaw gripper systems, making transfer to multi-finger hands challenging, particularly as teleoperation datasets are harder to collect with multi-fingered robots. Abstract: A latent safety filter decides from the latent of a world model whether a planned action is safe. Conformal calibration sets the threshold of the filter so that it accepts an unsafe action only with a small probability. We call the share of safe transitions that lie in such cells the overlap. Abstract: Once deployed on vehicles, end-to-end driving models continuously encounter challenging scenarios, generating valuable human takeover data that capture both model outputs and human behaviors. We first construct diverse trajectory candidates by augmenting the plans of the deployed model and shifting recorded human corrective maneuvers earlier in time. Abstract: Diffusion and flow-matching policies have become a standard choice for visuomotor imitation learning, owing to their ability to model multimodal action distributions. In memory-dependent manipulation, the robot must act on information that is no longer visible. Existing methods feed the observation history to the policy as an additional condition, while action generation still starts from Gaussian noise. However, the policy must then pick out the relevant target from a long and redundant history, leading to spurious correlations and unreliable decisions as the memory load grows. Additionally, the initial noise carries no information about what the robot has seen, leaving generation without guidance toward the remembered target. To address these issues, we propose RecallFlow, a flow-policy framework that builds the source distribution from episodic memory. For this task, the key lies in improving navigation policies from earlier searches to locate subsequent goals more efficiently. Recent methods automate this process through trajectory reflection and rule revision, enabling policy self-improvement. Consequently, the system's capacity for continued self-improvement remains constrained, even as its navigation policy evolves. articles.title: CoT-WAM: Collaborative Training of Vision-Language Models and World-Action Models via Plan Latents
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.23803v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: General robot manipulation requires both semantic competence and physical foresight. World action models (WAMs) acquire an understanding of and predictive capability over the physical world by jointly modeling visual foresight and action distributions. However, existing WAMs still lack semantic competence: they have limited ability to perform open-world scene understanding, semantic reasoning, and long-horizon planning. articles.title: UltraTex: Aligning Physical Knowledge for High-Fidelity PBR Texture Generation
articles.content: Generating physically based rendering (PBR) texture maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image is highly ambiguous, as the observed appearance entangles material identity, surface reflectance, and illumination. While current generative methods produce realistic albedo maps, they still struggle to infer accurate metallic and roughness attributes for relighting. We present UltraTex, a cascaded multi-view framework that moves beyond appearance matching by integrating physical knowledge into multi-view diffusion-based PBR generation. UltraTex first jointly predicts albedo and world-space shading normals to generate more detailed albedo maps, and then predicts metallic-roughness (MR) maps conditioned on the generated albedo, reference image, and material semantic priors. To inject material semantics, a lightweight adapter transforms hidden-layer features of a vision-language model (VLM) into intrinsic material representation tokens, providing part-level knowledge anchors for MR estimation. To model material-light interaction, photometric representation alignment guides intermediate diffusion features toward ground-truth material renderings under controlled lighting. This makes metallic and roughness variations observable through highlight intensity, specular sharpness, and local reflectance contrast, providing stronger guidance for fine-grained material prediction without explicit lighting supervision. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates high-quality textures and outperforms existing open-source and commercial methods in visual fidelity, material accuracy, and physical plausibility.

articles.title: $Z$-sight: Unifying Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
articles.content: We introduce $Z$-sight, a unified robot foundation model that couples vision-language-action (VLA) and generative latent world modeling. Video-based world action models (WAMs) show the value of joint future-and-action generation for control, yet inherit the heavy cost of video generators. Recent latent-space policies avoid pixel generation, yet typically align intermediate features or rely on frozen target encoders, decoupling future prediction from the VLM's native feature space. $Z$-sight instead predicts the future directly in the visual token space in which its VLM perceives the present. Coupling a foresight expert and a continuous action expert with the VLM in a mixture-of-transformers, $Z$-sight jointly denoises future spatial tokens and actions at inference without pixel reconstruction or external encoders. Trained on human video and robot trajectories, $Z$-sight achieves 81.9% success on SIMPLE (+9.6 points over the strongest baseline) and 73.3% across six Unitree G1 tasks (+20.0 points) at 110 ms per chunk, while remaining competitive on tabletop benchmarks.
